content: Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko Yoyɑkimu Yosiɑsin biin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nnɛse sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Yeremi ɡɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ tireru suo, kpɑ ɑ ɡɑri yi yore yi nɑ rɑɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ bwese tukunu kpuron sɔ̃ sɑɑ dɔmɑ tèn di nɑ kɑ nun ɡɑri toruɑ Yosiɑsin wɑɑti sɔɔ n kɑ ɡisɔ ɡirɑri.
Yudɑbɑ bɑ̀ n nuɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye kon bu kuɑ sɔrɔkudo bɑ koo ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ bu ben kom kɔ̃sum deri. Sɑɑ yerɑ kon bu ben durum wɔkɑ.
Yen biru Yeremi u Bɑruku Nɛriyɑn bii sokɑ mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro ye Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ Bɑruku u ye yoruɑ tire te sɔɔ.
Yerɑ Yeremi u mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee bɑ mɑn mwɑ bɑ nɛni, nɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.

Yen sɔ̃, dɔmɑ te bɑ koo nɔɔ bɔke, ɑ doo wunɛn tii, kpɑ ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɑ yore mi ɡɑri sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi. Kpɑ Yudɑ be bɑ koo nɑ sɑɑ ben wusun di kɑ sere mɑɑ tɔn be bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro bu yi nɔ.
Sɔrɔkudo bɑ koo ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ bu ben dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ deri, kpɑ bu Yinni Gusunɔ suuru kɑnɑ. Domi win mɔru yɑ kpɑ̃ ye u kɑ bu mɔ̀.
Yerɑ Bɑruku Nɛriyɑn bii wi, u kuɑ kpuro ye Yeremi u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi ɡɑrɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten mi.
Yoyɑkimun bɑn ten wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbuse sɔɔ, yen suru nɔɔbɑ nnɛse sɔɔ, yerɑ bɑ nɔɔ bɔkurun tɔ̃ru yi tè sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu kɑ Yudɑbɑ kpuro bɑ koo nɑ bu nɔɔ bɔke Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.

Yen tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔrɑ Bɑruku u Yeremin ɡɑri yi ɡɑrɑ tɔn ben wuswɑɑɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, sɑɑ Gemɑriɑ, Sɑfɑnin biin dirun di, wi u sɑ̃ɑ tire yoro. Dii te, tɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ kɔnnɔ kpɔɔn berɑ ɡiɑ, ɡunɡuru wɔllɔ.
Misee u wiruɡibu
tire ten ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ
Ye Misee Gemɑriɑn bii, Sɑfɑnin debubu u Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi nuɑ yi bɑ yoruɑ tire te sɔɔ,

yerɑ u dɑ sinɑ bokon yɛnuɔ sere win tire yoron dirɔ. Mɑ u deemɑ wiruɡii beni bɑ mɛnnɛ mi. Beyɑ, tire yoro Elisɑmɑ kɑ Delɑyɑ Semɑyɑn bii, kɑ Ɛlinɑtɑni, Akɑborin bii, kɑ Gemɑriɑ Sɑfɑnin bii, kɑ Sedesiɑsi Hɑnɑniɑn bii kɑ sere wiruɡii be bɑ tie.
Mɑ Misee u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro ɡɑri yi u nuɑ Bɑruku u tɔn be ɡɑriɑ.
Yenibɑn biru, wiruɡii be, bɑ Bɑruku Yehudi Nɛtɑniɑn bii, Selemiɑn debubu, Kusin sikɑdobu ɡɔriɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u kɑ tire te nɑ te u Yudɑbɑ ɡɑriɑ mi. Mɑ Bɑruku u tire te suɑ u kɑ dɑ.
Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ sinɔ kpɑ ɑ sun tire te ɡɑriɑ. Mɑ Bɑruku u sinɑ u bu tu ɡɑriɑ.
Ye bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ bɑ mɛɛrinɑ kɑ nɑndɑbu mɑ bɑ Bɑruku bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɔ nɡe mɛ ɑ koosinɑ ɑ kɑ ɡɑri yi yoruɑ. Sɑ ko kɑ yi sinɑ boko dɑɑwɑwɑ.
Yerɑ Bɑruku u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, Yeremiwɑ u mɑn ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ nɑ yorumɔ tireru sɔɔ kɑ ɑnkiri.
Mɑ wiruɡii be, bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, i doo i kuke wunɛ kɑ Yeremi, kpɑ ɡoo u ku rɑɑ bɛɛ wɑ.
Sinɑ boko u tire te dɔ̃ɔ mɛni
Yenibɑn biru, wiruɡibɑ tire te mwɑ bɑ beruɑ Elisɑmɑ tire yoron dirɔ. Mɑ bɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi, bɑ nùn ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u Yehudi ɡɔrɑ u nɛɛ, u doo u tire te suɑmɑ. Mɑ u dɑ Elisɑmɑn dirɔ u tu suɑmɑ u ɡɑrɑ sinɑ boko kɑ wiruɡii ben wuswɑɑɔ.
N deemɑ sɑɑ ye, purɑn sɑɑwɑ. Wɔ̃ɔn suru nɔɔbɑ nnɛse sɔɔrɑ mɛ. Mɑ u deemɑ sinɑ boko u sɔ̃ u dɔ̃ɔ wɔ̃su win diru mi u rɑ sinɛ purɑn sɑɑ.
Yehudi ù n tire ten kɑburɑ itɑ, ǹ kun mɛ nnɛ ɡɑrɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ sinɑ boko u rɑ tire yoron kɔ̃ɔ piibu ɡɑɡu sue u kɑ mi bɑ ɡɑrɑ burɑ u kpɛ̃ɛ dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ, sere te kpuro tɑ kɑ dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ muku muku.
Ye sinɑ boko kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ ye kpuro nuɑ bɑ ǹ nɑnde, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ben yɑ̃nu ɡɛ̃ɛkɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ ko nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.
Sinɑ boko u sere tire te dɔ̃ɔ mɛni, Ɛlinɑtɑni kɑ Delɑyɑ kɑ Gemɑriɑ bɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ ɡem ɡem u ku kɑ tu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni. Adɑmɑ u ǹ bu swɑɑ dɑki.

Yerɑ sinɑ boko u Yerɑmɛɛli wi u sɑ̃ɑ sunɔn bii, kɑ Serɑyɑ Asiriɛlin bii, kɑ Selemiɑ Abudɛlin bii woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu tire yoro Bɑruku kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Yeremi mwɑɑmɑ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔ u bu beruɑ, bɑ ǹ bu wɑ.
Yeremi
u tire ten kpɑɑru yoruɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ sinɑ boko u tire te dɔ̃ɔ mɛni, te Yeremi u Bɑruku sɔ̃ɔwɑ u yore mi, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ mɑɑ tire kpɑɑru suo kpɑ ɑ ɡɑri yi yore yi yi rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ tire te sɔɔ, te sinɑ boko Yoyɑkimu u dɔ̃ɔ mɛni mi.

Kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Wee u tire te dɔ̃ɔ mɛni, mɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ wunɛ Yeremi ɑ yoruɑ mɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u koo nɑ kpɑ u tem mɛ kɑm koosiɑ, kpɑ u mɛn tɔmbu kɑ mɛn yɑɑ sɑbenu ɡurɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ wi sinɑ boko Yoyɑkimu sɔ̃ɔmɔ, mɑ win ɡoo kun mɑɑ sinɑmɔ Dɑfidin sinɑ ɡɔnɑ sɔɔ. Mɛyɑ bɑ koo mɑɑ win tiin ɡoru deri tɔɔwɔ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru tɑ n sɔ̃ɔ kɑ purɑ soorɑmɔ.
Kon bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ ben durum sɔ̃ wi kɑ win bibun bweseru, kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu. Kon de kɔ̃sɑ yu Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu kɑ Yudɑbɑ deemɑ, ye nɑ rɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ, yèn sɔ̃ bɑ ǹ wure bu mɑn swɑɑ dɑki.
Mɑ Yeremi u tireru ɡɑru suɑ u Bɑruku, Nɛriyɑn bii, wi u sɑ̃ɑ tire yoro wɛ̃. Yerɑ u mɑɑ nùn tire te Yoyɑkimu u dɔ̃ɔ mɛni min ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro. Mɑ u yi yoruɑ u mɑɑ ɡɑri ɡɛɛ yoruɑ yi yi kɑ yi weenɛ.
Sedesiɑsi
u Yeremi ɡɔrɑ u bu Gusunɔ kɑnɑ
